name: core
description: Hardware references and firmware-development helpers for M5Stack's Core-family Controllers: Core2 (plain and For AWS, all four revisions) and Tab5. Covers pinouts, I2C addresses, power management, display/touch, audio, IMU, and setup for Arduino IDE, PlatformIO, ESP-IDF, and UIFlow. Pairs with the esp32-chips plugin for chip-level depth.
